tools.name: workers_list
tools.description:
List all Workers in your Cloudflare account.

If you only need details of a single Worker, use workers_get_worker.

tools.name: workers_get_worker
tools.description: Get the details of the Cloudflare Worker.

scriptName.description: The name of the worker script to retrieve

tools.name: workers_get_worker_code
tools.description: Get the source code of a Cloudflare Worker. Note: This may be a bundled version of the worker.

scriptName.description: The name of the worker script to retrieve

tools.name: workers_builds_list_builds
tools.description:
Use the Workers Builds API to list builds for a Cloudflare Worker.

workerId is required. Use workers_list to find a Worker's ID when needed.

workerId.description: The Worker ID to list builds for.

perPage.description: The number of builds per page.

tools.name: workers_builds_get_build
tools.description:
Get details for a specific build by its UUID.
Includes build and deploy commands for the build (useful for debugging build failures).

buildUUID.description: The build UUID to get details for.

tools.name: workers_builds_get_build_logs
tools.description: Get logs for a Cloudflare Workers build by its explicit UUID.

buildUUID.description: The build UUID to get logs for.
